method: Likelihood and impact are scored 1-5; inherent and residual scores are likelihood multiplied by impact. Management must approve ratings and treatment before the Type I as-of date.

risks.risk: Unauthorized cross-tenant access to restricted dossier information
risks.treatment: Production authentication, server-derived owner identity, persistence-layer ownership checks, regression tests

risks.risk: Compromised privileged account or source/deployment credential
risks.treatment: Server secret separation and vendor identity controls; enforce MFA, least privilege, access review and rapid revocation

risks.risk: Malicious or malformed PDF compromises processing or introduces malware
risks.treatment: Private PDF-only upload grants, size/page/signature validation; add quarantine and malware scanning

risks.risk: Restricted content is sent to an unapproved AI provider or retained contrary to contract
risks.treatment: External processing disabled by default, explicit hosted opt-in, customer gateway, sanitization, fail-closed routing

risks.risk: AI output introduces unsupported regulatory or scientific claims
risks.treatment: Verified-claim constraints, citation markers, schema validation, deterministic fallbacks, mandatory human review

risks.risk: Critical cloud vendor outage or data loss prevents service or recovery
risks.treatment: Documented continuity plan and vendor-managed resilience; verify backups and exercise restoration

risks.risk: Security incident is not detected, escalated, or notified promptly
risks.treatment: Incident plan and privacy-safe errors; implement central telemetry, monitored alerting, contacts and tabletop

risks.risk: Third-party processor fails security, privacy, retention, or availability obligations
risks.treatment: Subprocessor inventory and pre-use review requirements; complete contractual and annual vendor evidence reviews

risks.risk: Known vulnerable dependency or unauthorized change reaches production
risks.treatment: CI, static checks, Dependabot, immutable actions, tests and SBOM; add licensed/independent vulnerability scanning, protected releases, provenance and remediation metrics

risks.risk: Retention or deletion commitments are not completed across primary stores and backups
risks.treatment: Primary-record deletion removes scoped artifacts and caches; add schedules, legal holds, receipts and backup-expiry evidence
